ei.title: Automation and the Value of Creativity
ei.subject: 11월_2022 고1 모의고사
ei.lesson: Automation and the Value of Creativity

fullPassage: Things are changing. It has been reported that 42 percent of jobs in Canada are at risk, and 62 percent of jobs in America will be in danger due to advances in automation. You might say that the numbers seem a bit unrealistic, but the threat is real. One fast food franchise has a robot that can flip a burger in ten seconds. It is just a simple task but the robot could replace an entire crew. Highly skilled jobs are also at risk. A supercomputer, for instance, can suggest available treatments for specific illnesses in an automated way, drawing on the body of medical research and data on diseases. However, what's difficult to automate is the ability to creatively solve problems. Whereas workers in "doing" roles can be replaced by robots, the role of creatively solving problems is more dependent on an irreplaceable individual.

questions.passage: Things are changing. It has been reported that 42 percent of jobs in Canada are at risk, and 62 percent of jobs in America will be in danger due to advances in automation. You might say that the numbers seem a bit unrealistic, but the threat is (A)[false / real]. One fast food franchise has a robot that can flip a burger in ten seconds. It is just a simple task but the robot could (B)[replace / assist] an entire crew. Highly skilled jobs are also at risk. A supercomputer, for instance, can suggest available treatments for specific illnesses in an automated way, drawing on the body of medical research and data on diseases. However, what's (C)[easy / difficult] to automate is the ability to creatively solve problems. Whereas workers in "doing" roles can be replaced by robots, the role of creatively solving problems is more dependent on an irreplaceable individual.
questions.stem: 다음 글의 (A), (B), (C)에 들어갈 말로 가장 적절한 것끼리 짝지은 것은?

det.korean: (A) real=실재하는, (B) replace=대체하다, (C) difficult=어려운. 위협은 실재하고, 로봇이 인력을 대체할 수 있으며, 창의적 문제 해결은 자동화하기 어렵다.
det.analysis:
✅ ① real - replace - difficult: 위협은 실재하고(real), 로봇이 대체하며(replace), 자동화가 어렵다(difficult). 원문 일치 ←정답
❌ ② false - replace - difficult: (A) false(거짓의)는 '위협은 실재한다'는 문맥에 반대
❌ ③ real - assist - difficult: (B) assist(돕다)는 '인력을 대체한다'는 문맥에 반대
❌ ④ real - replace - easy: (C) easy(쉬운)는 '자동화하기 어렵다'는 문맥에 반대
det.tip: 위협은 실재한다(real) → 대체하다(replace) → 자동화가 어렵다(difficult)

questions.passage: Things are changing. It has been reported that 42 percent of jobs in Canada are at risk, and 62 percent of jobs in America will be in danger due to advances in automation. You might say that the numbers seem a bit (A)[realistic / unrealistic], but the threat is real. One fast food franchise has a robot that can flip a burger in ten seconds. It is just a simple task but the robot could replace an entire crew. Highly (B)[skilled / unskilled] jobs are also at risk. A supercomputer, for instance, can suggest available treatments for specific illnesses in an automated way, drawing on the body of medical research and data on diseases. However, what's difficult to automate is the ability to creatively solve problems. Whereas workers in "doing" roles can be replaced by robots, the role of creatively solving problems is more dependent on an (C)[replaceable / irreplaceable] individual.
questions.stem: 다음 글의 (A), (B), (C)에 들어갈 말로 가장 적절한 것끼리 짝지은 것은?

det.analysis:
❌ ① realistic - skilled - irreplaceable: (A) realistic(현실적인)은 '수치가 비현실적으로 보인다'는 문맥에 반대
✅ ② unrealistic - skilled - irreplaceable: 수치가 비현실적으로 보이고(unrealistic), 고숙련(skilled) 직업도 위험하며, 대체 불가능한(irreplaceable) 개인에 의존. 원문 일치 ←정답
❌ ③ unrealistic - unskilled - irreplaceable: (B) unskilled(비숙련의)는 'Highly skilled jobs'와 반대
❌ ④ unrealistic - skilled - replaceable: (C) replaceable(대체 가능한)은 'irreplaceable individual'과 반대
det.tip: 비현실적으로 보인다(unrealistic) → 고숙련(skilled) → 대체 불가능한(irreplaceable)

questions.passage: Things are changing. It has been reported that 42 percent of jobs in Canada are at risk, and 62 percent of jobs in America will be in danger due to (A)[declines / advances] in automation. You might say that the numbers seem a bit unrealistic, but the threat is real. One fast food franchise has a robot that can flip a burger in ten seconds. It is just a simple task but the robot could replace an entire crew. Highly skilled jobs are also at risk. A supercomputer, for instance, can suggest (B)[available / unavailable] treatments for specific illnesses in an automated way, drawing on the body of medical research and data on diseases. However, what's difficult to automate is the ability to creatively solve problems. Whereas workers in "doing" roles can be replaced by robots, the role of creatively solving problems is more (C)[independent / dependent] on an irreplaceable individual.
questions.stem: 다음 글의 (A), (B), (C)에 들어갈 말로 가장 적절한 것끼리 짝지은 것은?

det.analysis:
❌ ① declines - available - dependent: (A) declines(쇠퇴)는 '자동화의 발전'이라는 문맥에 반대
❌ ② advances - unavailable - dependent: (B) unavailable(이용 불가능한)은 '이용 가능한 치료법을 제안한다'는 문맥에 반대
✅ ③ advances - available - dependent: 자동화의 발전(advances), 이용 가능한(available) 치료, 개인에 의존하는(dependent). 원문 일치 ←정답
❌ ④ advances - available - independent: (C) independent(독립적인)는 'dependent on an individual'과 반대
det.tip: 자동화의 발전(advances) → 이용 가능한(available) → ~에 의존하는(dependent on)

questions.passage: Things are ①<u>changing</u>. It has been reported that 42 percent of jobs in Canada are at risk, and 62 percent of jobs in America will be in ②<u>danger</u> due to advances in automation. You might say that the numbers seem a bit unrealistic, but the threat is ③<u>real</u>. One fast food franchise has a robot that can flip a burger in ten seconds. It is just a simple task but the robot could ④<u>assist</u> an entire crew. Highly skilled jobs are also at risk. A supercomputer, for instance, can suggest available treatments for specific illnesses in an automated way, drawing on the body of medical research and data on diseases. However, what's difficult to automate is the ability to creatively solve problems. Whereas workers in "doing" roles can be replaced by robots, the role of creatively solving problems is more dependent on an irreplaceable individual.
questions.stem: 다음 글의 밑줄 친 ①~④ 중, 문맥상 낱말의 쓰임이 적절하지 않은 것은?

det.analysis:
❌ ① changing - 상황이 변하고 있다. 원문 적절
❌ ② danger - 미국 일자리가 위험에 처할 것이다. 원문 적절
❌ ③ real - 위협은 실재한다. 원문 적절
✅ ④ assist - 원문 replace. 로봇이 인력 전체를 대체할 수 있다는 맥락이므로 assist(돕다)는 부적절 ←정답
det.tip: replace an entire crew(인력 전체를 대체하다) vs assist(돕다)

questions.passage: Things are changing. It has been reported that 42 percent of jobs in Canada are at risk, and 62 percent of jobs in America will be in danger due to advances in automation. You might say that the numbers seem a bit unrealistic, but the threat is real. One fast food franchise has a robot that can flip a burger in ten seconds. It is just a ①<u>complex</u> task but the robot could replace an entire crew. Highly ②<u>skilled</u> jobs are also at risk. A supercomputer, for instance, can suggest available treatments for specific illnesses in an automated way, drawing on the body of medical research and data on diseases. However, what's difficult to ③<u>automate</u> is the ability to creatively solve problems. Whereas workers in "doing" roles can be replaced by robots, the role of creatively solving problems is more dependent on an irreplaceable ④<u>individual</u>.
questions.stem: 다음 글의 밑줄 친 ①~④ 중, 문맥상 낱말의 쓰임이 적절하지 않은 것은?

det.analysis:
✅ ① complex - 원문 simple. 버거 뒤집기는 그저 단순한(simple) 작업이라는 맥락이므로 complex(복잡한)는 부적절 ←정답
❌ ② skilled - 고숙련 직업도 위험하다. 원문 적절
❌ ③ automate - 자동화하기 어렵다. 원문 적절
❌ ④ individual - 대체 불가능한 개인. 원문 적절
det.tip: just a simple task(그저 단순한 작업) vs complex(복잡한)

questions.passage: Things are changing. It has been reported that 42 percent of jobs in Canada are at risk, and 62 percent of jobs in America will be in danger due to advances in automation. It is just a simple task but the robot could replace an entire crew. Highly skilled jobs are also at risk. A supercomputer, for instance, can suggest ②<u>unavailable</u> treatments for specific illnesses in an automated way, drawing on the body of medical research and data on diseases. However, what's difficult to ③<u>automate</u> is the ability to creatively solve problems. Whereas workers in "doing" roles can be replaced by robots, the role of creatively solving problems is more dependent on an ④<u>irreplaceable</u> individual.
questions.stem: 다음 글의 밑줄 친 ①~④ 중, 문맥상 낱말의 쓰임이 적절하지 않은 것은?

det.analysis:
❌ ① unrealistic - 수치가 비현실적으로 보인다. 원문 적절
✅ ② unavailable - 원문 available. 슈퍼컴퓨터가 이용 가능한(available) 치료법을 제안한다는 맥락이므로 unavailable(이용 불가능한)은 부적절 ←정답
❌ ③ automate - 자동화하기 어렵다. 원문 적절
❌ ④ irreplaceable - 대체 불가능한 개인. 원문 적절
det.tip: suggest available treatments(이용 가능한 치료법을 제안하다) vs unavailable(이용 불가능한)

questions.stem: 다음 글의 빈칸에 들어갈 말로 가장 적절한 것은?

det.analysis:
❌ ① benefit: 이득. 일자리가 위험하다는 문맥과 반대
❌ ② solution: 해결책. 문맥상 부적합
✅ ③ threat: 위협. 자동화로 일자리가 위험하다는 부정적 문맥에 부합 ←정답
❌ ④ comfort: 위안. 위험을 강조하는 문맥과 부적합
det.tip: but the ______ is real → threat (위협은 실재한다)

det.korean: 로봇이 인력 전체를 대체할(replace) 수 있다
det.analysis:
❌ ① train: 훈련시키다. 로봇이 사람을 훈련한다는 것은 문맥 부적합
❌ ② hire: 고용하다. 문맥 부적합
❌ ③ pay: 지불하다. 문맥 부적합
✅ ④ replace: 대체하다. 로봇이 인력 전체를 대신한다는 맥락 ←정답

questions.stem: 다음 글의 빈칸에 들어갈 말로 가장 적절한 것은?

det.korean: 창의적 문제 해결은 대체 불가능한(irreplaceable) 개인에 의존한다
det.analysis:
✅ ① irreplaceable: 대체 불가능한. 창의적 문제 해결이 사람에게 의존한다는 결론에 부합 ←정답
❌ ② ordinary: 평범한. 창의성의 가치를 강조하는 문맥과 부적합
❌ ③ temporary: 일시적인. 문맥 부적합
❌ ④ replaceable: 대체 가능한. 자동화가 어렵다는 결론과 반대
det.tip: dependent on an ______ individual → irreplaceable (대체 불가능한)

det.analysis:

❌ ③ failures: 실패. 반대 의미
❌ ④ declines: 쇠퇴. 반대 의미
det.tip: advances = developments (발전, 진보)

questions.stem: 다음 글의 밑줄 친 available와 의미가 가장 반대인 것은?

questions.passage:
(A) A supercomputer can draw on the <u>body</u> of medical research to help doctors.
(B) Daily exercise keeps your <u>body</u> healthy and full of energy.
questions.stem: 다음 (A), (B)의 밑줄 친 body의 문맥적 의미로 가장 적절한 것은?

det.korean: (A): 축적된 자료(the body of research=연구 자료의 집합체) - (B): 신체(사람의 몸)
det.analysis:
❌ ① (A): 신체 - (B): 축적된 자료: 의미가 반대로 배치됨
❌ ② (A): 신체 - (B): 신체: (A)는 '자료의 집합체'
✅ ③ (A): 축적된 자료(집합체) - (B): 신체: the body of research는 '연구 자료 전체', 운동은 '몸'을 건강하게 함 ←정답
❌ ④ (A): 축적된 자료 - (B): 축적된 자료: (B)는 '신체'
det.tip: the body of research=자료의 집합체 / keep your body healthy=신체(몸)

questions.stem: 다음 영영 정의에 해당하는 단어로 가장 적절한 것은? "the use of machines and computers to do work that people used to do"

det.korean: automation: 사람이 하던 일을 기계와 컴퓨터가 하도록 하는 것(자동화)
det.analysis:
❌ ① treatment: 치료. 정의와 무관
❌ ② research: 연구. 정의와 무관
❌ ③ threat: 위협. 정의와 무관
✅ ④ automation: 자동화. 기계·컴퓨터가 사람의 일을 대신한다는 정의에 부합 ←정답
det.tip: automation = the use of machines to do work people used to do (자동화)

questions.passage: Things are changing. It has been reported that 42 percent of jobs in Canada are at risk, and 62 percent of jobs in America will be in danger due to advances in __________ (automate).
questions.stem: 다음 글의 빈칸에 괄호 안의 단어를 알맞은 형태로 바꿔 쓰시오. (1단어) (영어로)

det.analysis: 동사 automate(자동화하다)를 명사형 automation(자동화)으로 변환. 전치사 in 뒤에는 명사가 와야 하고, 'advances in automation(자동화의 발전)'이 자연스럽다.
det.tip: automate(동사) → automation(명사, 자동화)

questions.passage: However, what's difficult to automate is the ability to creatively solve problems. Whereas workers in "doing" roles can be replaced by robots, the role of creatively solving problems is more __________ (depend) on an irreplaceable individual.
questions.stem: 다음 글의 빈칸에 괄호 안의 단어를 알맞은 형태로 바꿔 쓰시오. (1단어) (영어로)

det.analysis: 동사 depend(의존하다)를 형용사형 dependent(의존하는)로 변환. 'be more dependent on ~(~에 더 의존하다)' 구문에서 be동사 뒤 보어로 형용사가 필요하다.
det.tip: depend(동사) → dependent (형용사). be dependent on ~ = ~에 의존하다

questions.passage: Things are changing. It has been reported that 42 percent of jobs in Canada are at risk, and 62 percent of jobs in America will be in danger due to advances in automation. You might say that the numbers seem a bit unrealistic, but the threat is real. One fast food franchise has a robot that can flip a burger in ten seconds. It is just a simple task but the robot could __________. Highly skilled jobs are also at risk. A supercomputer, for instance, can suggest available treatments for specific illnesses in an automated way, drawing on the body of medical research and data on diseases. However, what's difficult to automate is the ability to creatively solve problems. Whereas workers in "doing" roles can be replaced by robots, the role of creatively solving problems is more dependent on an irreplaceable individual.
questions.stem: 다음 글의 빈칸에 들어갈 말로 가장 적절한 것은?

det.korean: 그 단순한 작업이지만 로봇이 인력 전체를 대체할 수 있다
det.analysis:
✅ ① replace an entire crew: 단순 작업이라도 로봇 하나가 팀 전체를 대신할 수 있다는 위협을 강조 ←정답
❌ ② flip a burger quickly: 앞 문장에 이미 나온 정보의 반복
❌ ③ work without any rest: 본문에 없는 내용
❌ ④ learn to cook new dishes: 본문에 없는 내용
det.tip: the robot could ______ → replace an entire crew (인력 전체를 대체하다)

questions.passage: Things are changing. It has been reported that 42 percent of jobs in Canada are at risk, and 62 percent of jobs in America will be in danger due to advances in automation. You might say that the numbers seem a bit unrealistic, but the threat is real. One fast food franchise has a robot that can flip a burger in ten seconds. It is just a simple task but the robot could replace an entire crew. Highly skilled jobs are also at risk. A supercomputer, for instance, can suggest available treatments for specific illnesses in an automated way, drawing on the body of medical research and data on diseases. However, what's difficult to automate is the ability to creatively solve problems. Whereas workers in "doing" roles can be replaced by robots, the role of creatively solving problems is more dependent on __________.
questions.stem: 다음 글의 빈칸에 들어갈 말로 가장 적절한 것은?

det.korean: 창의적 문제 해결의 역할은 대체 불가능한 개인에 더 의존한다
det.analysis:
❌ ① a well-trained robot: 로봇은 대체 가능한 존재로 글의 결론과 반대
✅ ② an irreplaceable individual: 창의적 문제 해결은 기계가 아닌 대체 불가능한 사람에 달려 있다는 결론 ←정답
❌ ③ an automated machine: 자동화 기계는 창의성이 없다고 했으므로 반대
❌ ④ a simple software program: 본문 취지와 반대
det.tip: more dependent on ______ → an irreplaceable individual (대체 불가능한 개인)
